description: Ethiopian police are urging residents of Tigray’s capital to assist in restoring order after the withdrawal of rebel forces. The situation remains tense with reports of Eritrean troops entering Ethiopia.

description: Violent clashes erupted between youths and police in Brussels during a national strike against austerity measures. Police used water cannons and tear gas to disperse the crowd.

description: Israel strongly criticized the Nobel Peace Prize given to Navi Pillay, stating it perpetuates anti-Israel hatred. Pillay led a UN inquiry accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza.

description: GENEVA: Almost all of Gaza’s population need tents or help with shelter ahead of winter, with the El Niño weather phenomenon expected to bring heavier rainfall, while supplies remain scarce due to Israeli restrictions, the UN migration agency said on Friday. title: South African judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
description: Navi Pillay, a South African judge, has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her significant contributions in prosecuting war crimes and genocide, particularly her work on the Rwanda genocide tribunal and UN commission reports.

title: India in talks with Saudi Arabia for investment in strategic port projects
description: India is negotiating with Saudi Arabia for investments in key port projects, including Vadhavan and Galathea Bay, aimed at enhancing maritime cooperation and developing a strong shipping partnership. The talks, held during South Asia's largest maritime conference, involve establishing a joint working group for collaboration in the maritime sector, with both nations aiming to foster trade and improve shipping capacity in the region.

description: The Estonian company, which has announced a Shahed-like target drone, will show its products at this year's AUSA conference in Washington.

title: Residents of Ukraine's Kramatorsk forced to flee as drone strikes intensify
description: The city of Kramatorsk, in eastern Ukraine, is increasingly coming under Russian attack. For those who have stayed behind, the threat from drones and shelling has become a daily reality. Many have resisted leaving their homes, despite the growing danger – but now, more and more residents are being forced to flee. Our colleagues at France 2 followed an evacuation from the city and witnessed first-hand the dangers that residents face.

title: Eritrea and Ethiopia accuse each other of provoking war as Tigray rebels retreat
description: Ethiopia and Eritrea on Friday accused each other of starting a "war of agresson" days after the two countries severed diplomatic ties. Ethiopian officals estimate that up to 8,000 Eritrean soldiers are present in Tigray supporting rebels who last month launched attacks against federal forces.
